onboarding.welcomeTitle: Welcome to Your AI Study Companion
onboarding.welcomeSubtitle: Turn photo notes and documents into summaries, flashcards, and smart quizzes.
onboarding.step1Desc: Snap book pages, lecture sheets, or upload PDF/DOCX files with ease.
onboarding.step2Desc: Read clear key points, definitions, and transparent content limitations.
onboarding.step3Desc: Review with spaced flashcards and test your knowledge with quizzes.
onboarding.consentDesc: This application sends photos, documents, and chat messages to our servers and AI providers to extract text and generate study materials. Your data is secure and you may permanently delete all your data at any time.
onboarding.privacyModalContent: Your uploaded documents, photos, and chat interactions are securely processed solely for generating your personalized learning materials. We do not sell or distribute your data. You maintain the right to delete all your data permanently at any time from Settings.
